title: John Calvin
source: Public domain. Consolidated from John Calvin, Commentary on the Epistles to the Corinthians, translated by John Pringle, Calvin Translation Society, and the Institutes of the Christian Religion, translated by Henry Beveridge; both as published by the Christian Classics Ethereal Library.
body: John Calvin on Second Corinthians, chapter 6. In his Commentary on the Epistles to the Corinthians, in the John Pringle translation, Calvin writes at Second Corinthians 6, verse 1: Assisting. He has repeated the instructions of embassy with which the ministers of the gospel have been furnished by God. In the Institutes of the Christian Religion, in the Henry Beveridge translation, Calvin draws on this chapter again in Book 1, chapter 13.
